decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The fees levied by the National Intellectual Property Office of Sri Lanka for its services have been last amended through the Regulations published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2146/37 dated 2019-10-27. The Intellectual Property Regulations No.01 of 2026 formulated in accordance with the provisions of the Intellectual Property Act No.36 of 2003 by further amending the aforesaid fees in keeping with the current circumstances, have been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2509/17 dated 2026-10-06. The proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Co-operative Development to present the said Regulations in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
